newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close firm, market seen strong.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close firm, market seen strong.

text.p: Austrian shares closed on a buoyant note on Friday following record highs in Germany, with traders optimistic for further gains next week.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips added 10.15 points or 0.92 percent to 1,118.29. Among its constituents 17 ATX shares rose, three fell and one remained unchanged.
"Overall the market's at its strongest for weeks," said one trader. The ATX index saw a rise of two percent on the week's start.
"We have more volume again and confidence is obviously back in the market," another trader noted.
The next target for the ATX was seen around 1,130.
Traders held high hopes that regional utility EVN and oil and chemicals group OMV would build on recent strength.
The top gainer of the session was insurer EA Generali, up 3.51 percent at 3,540 schillings.
Ordinary shares in flagship bank Creditanstalt took the biggest fall, down 0.31 percent at 729 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index inched up 3.08 points or 0.73 percent to 423.9.
The December ATX future closed 8.9 points higher at 1,117.9. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
